title: Tire Line Price on Credit Replacement Tickets — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Tire line on a credit replacement ticket — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** The tire line of the one-tire replacement ticket written for an adjusted tire follows the set's age and the line's price basis:

| Set | Tire line |
|---|---|
| still within the line's free-replacement months — fewer than 12 whole calendar months from the purchase date (fewer than 24 on the Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty line) | like for like at the set's price per tire |
| older, on a line prorated on the original price per tire (Crestline Value Touring 40K and Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty) | the lower of the selling price recorded on the set's latest treadwear adjustment and the price paid per tire on the set's ticket |
| any other set | the selling price recorded on the set's latest treadwear adjustment |

The price paid per tire on the set's ticket is the price per tire, less the set instant savings divided by the tire count when the ticket received it, less the fleet discount taken on the tires invoice posted for the vehicle on the purchase date divided by the tire count when the ticket was charged to a fleet account. The fleet discount on a tires invoice is one percentage taken on every discountable line of the ticket, the tire price, the mounting and the valve-stem or TPMS-kit lines alike; wherever the tire price paid takes it off, the whole discount amount of that invoice is counted against the tire price, the part taken on the mounting and kit lines included, because those lines are never figured below the line's own charges here, and a ticket of an ordered set carries the tire price alone.

Free-replacement months in line order: 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 24.

**Cases (hypothetical 40K-line set, $120.00 a tire, no savings, recorded selling price $130.00):** 8 months old — $120.00; 20 months old — the lower of $130.00 and $120.00, $120.00. A 60K-line set 20 months old with a recorded selling price of $130.00 — $130.00.
